objective: Author and independently challenge one additive SSI v12 contract repair without experiment execution.

candidates.title: SSI canonical v12 explicit digest, source, terminal, semantic, replay, and baseline repair
candidates.uncertainty: Whether the v11 Red Team observation fibers can be closed in one typed design contract without hiding source advice, semantic edge work, finite terminal behavior, accounting, controls, or baseline scope.
candidates.positive_decision: Preserve a review-supported v12 design contract and name the next separately authorized materialization step; this batch still executes nothing.
candidates.negative_decision: Record the exact unresolved contract obstruction and keep v12 unfreezable; no mathematical negative about SSI or ECDLP follows.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Record REVISE and the cheapest remaining contract repair or falsification control; no experiment is admitted.
candidates.next_action: Snapshot v12, obtain independent Validator and Red Team verdicts, then archive a narrow Coordinator disposition.

ambiguities.question: Does v12 contract completeness authorize execution or establish an SSI result?
ambiguities.resolution: No. V12 has maximum_runs zero, execution_authorized false, evidence_eligible false, and explicit materialization gates.

candidates.dominated_by: Matched classical SSI/EndRing baselines remain the reference point; no Pareto improvement is claimed until semantic edges, controls, incumbent, and measured cost are materialized.

sota_delta.note: Design and review only; no algorithmic improvement is measured or claimed.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Immutable v12 snapshot plus independent review-adversarial verdicts bound to that snapshot.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: REVISE preserves v12 at unverified design status and names one bounded next action.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any unlisted local digest, missing shortened-frame length, source identity gap, finite predicate gap, semantic equation gap, charge gap, replay gap, control gap, or baseline scope gap is REVISE rather than inferred PASS.
peripheral_exclusions: Any experiment run or backend diagnostic
Provider, edge, control, or incumbent materialization
Any hypothesis or research-question status change
Any breakthrough, lower bound, security, exponent, or goal-completion claim
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: The independent reviews and Coordinator disposition are ledger-archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Exact contract reconstruction and independent adversarial review; no curve computation.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Design work is bounded by symbolic schema, digest, semantic, cost, and control review.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One active candidate; snapshot and archive tasks run alone, with Validator and Red Team reviewing only the snapshot.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one snapshot, two independent verdicts, and one ledger disposition, or immediately on archive-integrity failure.

stages.purpose: Validate focus, queue, preflight, and Git control plane.
stages.stop_rule: Stop if any opening or archive gate fails.

stages.dominant_operation: Wire, digest, quantifier, finite, semantic, cost, replay, control, and baseline design.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after declared producer artifacts or budget exhaustion.

stages.purpose: Snapshot and ledger-archive the bounded disposition.
stages.dominant_operation: Exact-path hashing, commits, and repository validation.
stages.stop_rule: Stop on any integrity mismatch; otherwise after verified ledger archive.
